premise: Pilot tells Robot he once rode an asteroid like a pony; Robot believes every word — then an asteroid tumbles past, and Pilot waves at it like an old friend.
inspiration: Baron Munchausen's tall tales (Raspe), turned: the tall tale leaves everyone wondering, and makes a friend in the sky.
lesson: A good story doesn't have to be true to be shared.

en-US.title: The Tallest Tale
en-US.text: {pilot:enter} {pilot:face happy} Did I ever tell you, said Pilot, about the time I rode a space rock? {robot:enter} {robot:face surprised} Robot shook his head. Well, said Pilot, I lassoed it with a cable and rode it round the Moon, twice, like a bucking pony. Yee-ha! {pilot:live} He waved his glowing wands to show how. [gasps] Really? {astronomer:enter} {astronomer:face happy} He's pulling your leg, said Astronomer. {robot:face normal} Robot checked both legs. [giggles] Nobody was pulling them. Just then, far above the ridge, an {asteroid:enter} asteroid came tumbling past. {pilot:face happy} Pilot waved up at it. Evening, Bumpy! {asteroid:live hold} The asteroid turned over, slow and lumpy, as if it were waving back. {robot:face surprised} Robot looked at the asteroid. {robot:pulse} Robot looked at Pilot. {robot:face happy} [laughs] I KNEW it! said Robot, {robot:live} and did a victory dance.

es-ES.title: El cuento más largo
es-ES.text: {pilot:enter} {pilot:face happy} ¿Te he contado alguna vez, dijo Piloto, cuando monté en una roca espacial? {robot:enter} {robot:face surprised} Robot negó con la cabeza. Pues nada, dijo Piloto, lo enlacé con un cable y di dos vueltas a la Luna montado en él, como en un potro salvaje. ¡Yijaaa! {pilot:live} Movió sus bastones luminosos para enseñárselo. [gasps] ¿De verdad? {astronomer:enter} {astronomer:face happy} Te está tomando el pelo, dijo Astrónoma. {robot:face normal} Robot se tocó la cabeza. [giggles] No tenía pelo que tomar. Justo entonces, muy por encima de la cordillera, pasó un {asteroid:enter} asteroide dando tumbos. {pilot:face happy} Piloto lo saludó. ¡Buenas noches, Pedrusco! {asteroid:live hold} El asteroide dio una vuelta, lento y abollado, como si le devolviera el saludo. {robot:face surprised} Robot miró al asteroide. {robot:pulse} Robot miró a Piloto. {robot:face happy} [laughs] ¡LO SABÍA! dijo Robot, {robot:live} y se marcó un baile de victoria.
